notes: 1.0.0 is the verified public baseline; GHSA-j5rx-vm8v-f7p3 is fixed there.
Issue #504 tracks the 1.0.1 security patch release from the reviewed develop tip.
The manual gate details below combine the published 1.0.0 baseline with local 1.0.1 evidence; candidate CI and maintainer review remain pending.
1.0.1 publication requires a reviewed PR to main and the three protected release.yml dispatches after merge.

gates.title: Release commit has a clean working tree
Execution semantics are complete
gates.detail: The 1.0.0 execution baseline is published. Directly constructed plans now enforce declared policies. The 1.0.1 local focused gate passed (170 tests), and the full suite passed (3654 tests, 36 skipped); CI and maintainer review remain pending.

gates.title: Performance budgets are enforced
gates.detail: The 15 calibrated performance budgets in docs/performance/budgets.json are unchanged from 1.0.0. The 1.0.1 CI performance lane and maintainer review are pending.

gates.title: Interoperability conformance is demonstrated
gates.detail: Version-pinned host fixtures established the published 1.0.0 interoperability baseline. The 1.0.1 changes touch core, HTTP and MCP boundaries; conformance CI and maintainer review are pending.

gates.title: Security program is reviewed
gates.detail: The 1.0.0 adversarial review is recorded in docs/THREAT_MODEL.md. The 1.0.1 candidate includes four post-1.0.0 security fixes: direct plan authorization, scope denial redaction, viewer-specific cache control and HTTP method matching. Local security and full-suite tests passed. A 2026-09-24 GitHub readback found zero open CodeQL, Dependabot and secret-scanning alerts; candidate CI and maintainer disposition remain required.

gates.title: Public API is ready for stability
gates.detail: The 1.0.1 patch adds no public API exports. The 166-name 1.0.0 inventory in docs/releases/1.0-api-classification.md remains the baseline; import and compatibility CI plus maintainer review are pending.

gates.title: Documentation reproduces supported applications
gates.detail: The 1.0.1 release notes describe the upgrade and security changes. All seven candidate wheels were installed and checked in a fresh Python 3.14 environment, and the documented-consumer suite passed locally; CI and maintainer review are pending.

gates.title: Publication workflow is rehearsed
gates.detail: The phased publication hash and candidate pinning fix is included. Fourteen 1.0.1 artifacts were built and validated, the seven wheels installed in a clean environment, and offline publication readiness passed locally. CI, protected-environment approval, PyPI verification and maintainer review are pending. Historical 1.0.0 evidence is in docs/releases/1.0-candidate-evidence.md.
